profile.summary: Mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Fastify (Node.js web framework) and TypeScript. Demonstrates deep knowledge of Fastify's internals, including route configuration, response serialization, and lifecycle hooks. Skilled in type-safe backend development, async/await patterns, and maintaining documentation and type definitions. Contributions focus on polish, debugging edge cases, and ensuring backward compatibility in framework-level components. Experience primarily in backend systems with no visible frontend or testing contributions.
